svg.desc: Wide Frutiger Metro vector software wallpaper, lively 2000s pop design. On the right third, a graceful adult woman shown in a clear side-profile silhouette from the waist up, recognizable facial outline and flowing long hair; one solid deep plum shape. Surround her with bold flowing swirls, stylized flowers, circles and starbursts. Flat palette of teal, coral, sunny yellow, plum and pale cream; crisp clean shapes. Leave the left half mostly cream negative space for software content. Full bleed, no text, logos, borders, panels or interface elements.
